module: Node "String" (provider). Provides a string ("Hello World" by default) on the value pin. Single-line or multi-line editing in the editor; line breaks are escaped (\n) on save.
notes: The imgui buffer is limited to 2048 characters.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Writes the string to the output.

drawCustomProperties.desc: "Multi Line" checkbox and input field (2048-character buffer).

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the editor.

_onSerialize.desc: Saves the node's state in the given table.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores the string (supports the old data.value format) and multiLine.
